title: Personality Traits, Technology Adoption, and Technical Efficiency: Evidence from Smallholder Rice Farms in Ghana
abstract: Although a large literature highlights the impact of personality traits on key labor market outcomes, evidence of their impact on agricultural production decisions remains limited. Data from 1,200 Ghanaian rice farmers suggest that noncognitive skills (polychronicity, work centrality, and optimism) significantly affect simple adoption decisions, returns from adoption, and technical efficiency in rice production, and that the size of the estimated impacts exceeds that of traditional human capital measures. Greater focus on personality traits relative to cognitive skills may help accelerate innovation diffusion in the short term, and help farmers to respond flexibly to new opportunities and risks in the longer term.
abstract_zh: 尽管大量文献强调了人格特质对关键劳动力市场结果的影响，但关于其对农业生产决策影响的证据仍然有限。来自1,200名加纳水稻农户的数据表明，非认知技能（多任务偏好、工作中心性和乐观主义）显著影响简单的采纳决策、采纳的回报以及水稻生产的技术效率，而且这些估计影响的大小超过了传统人力资本指标的影响。相对于认知技能，更加关注人格特质，可能有助于在短期内加速创新扩散，并在长期内帮助农民灵活应对新的机遇和风险。

title: Using satellite imagery to assess impacts of soil and water conservation measures: Evidence from Ethiopia's Tana-Beles watershed
abstract: Although efforts at soil and water conservation are routinely viewed as instrumental in reducing vulnerability to climate change, their impact has rarely been quantified. Combining data on the timing and intensity of soil and water conservation interventions in select Ethiopian watersheds from 2009 to 2016 with a pixel-level panel of vegetative cover and soil moisture data derived from satellite imagery makes it possible to assess the biophysical impacts of such measures using a difference-in-differences specification. The results point toward significant effects overall that vary by season, and that tree planting and other soil and water conservation activities are more effective on degraded than cultivated land. The results are consistent with before-after regressions for daily sediment load and stream flows in a subset of micro-watersheds. It thus appears that satellite imagery can improve the design and near-real-time monitoring of sustainable land management interventions for watersheds and landscape.
abstract_zh: 尽管水土保持工作通常被视为降低气候变化脆弱性的重要手段，但其影响很少得到量化。本研究将2009至2016年间埃塞俄比亚部分流域水土保持干预的时间和强度数据，与源自卫星图像的植被覆盖和土壤水分像素级面板数据相结合，运用双重差分设定评估了此类措施的生物物理影响。结果表明，总体上存在显著效应，且效应因季节而异，同时，植树造林和其他水土保持活动在退化土地上比在耕种土地上更为有效。这些结果与部分小流域的每日泥沙负荷和河流流量的前后回归结果相一致。因此，卫星图像似乎可以改善流域和景观可持续土地管理干预措施的设计和近实时监测。

title: Using Machine Learning to Assess Yield Impacts of Crop Rotation: Combining Satellite and Statistical Data for Ukraine
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
abstract: To overcome the constraints for policy and practice posed by limited availability of data on crop rotation, this paper applies machine learning to freely available satellite imagery to identify the rotational practices of more than 7,000 villages in Ukraine. Rotation effects estimated based on combining these data with survey-based yield information point toward statistically significant and economically meaningful effects that differ from what has been reported in the literature, highlighting the value of this approach. Independently derived indices of vegetative development and soil water content produce similar results, not only supporting the robustness of the results, but also suggesting that the opportunities for spatial and temporal disaggregation inherent in such data offer tremendous unexploited opportunities for policy-relevant analysis.
abstract_zh: 为克服作物轮作数据有限给政策与实践带来的制约，本文运用机器学习方法分析免费可得的卫星图像，识别了乌克兰7,000多个村庄的轮作做法。将这些数据与基于调查的单产信息相结合进行估计，得出的轮作效应具有统计显著性和经济意义，且与文献中的报告有所不同，这凸显了该方法的价值。独立导出的植被发育指数和土壤含水量指数得出了相似的结果，不仅支持了结果的稳健性，还表明此类数据固有的空间和时间分解机会，为政策相关分析提供了巨大的、尚未开发的机会。

title: Costs and Benefits of Land Fragmentation: Evidence from Rwanda
Does Large Farm Establishment Create Benefits for Neighboring Smallholders? Evidence from Ethiopia
abstract: Large-scale agricultural investment has expanded rapidly over the past decade, justified partly by the expectation that established smallholders will benefit from positive spillovers. We estimate spillovers between large and small farms in Ethiopia, using variation over time in proximity or intensity of exposure to large farms. We find that between 2004 and 2014, establishing commercial farms did not lead to job creation and provided only modest benefits in terms of technology, input market access, and resilience to crop shocks. This suggests that in Ethiopia a more strategic approach may be needed to maximize benefits from large farm formation for smallholders. (JEL Q18, Q24)
abstract_zh: 过去十年，大规模农业投资迅速扩张，其部分理由是，已有的小农户将从正向溢出效应中受益。本文利用大农场与小农场之间的接近程度或暴露强度随时间的变化，估计了埃塞俄比亚大小农场之间的溢出效应。我们发现，2004至2014年间，设立商业农场并未带来就业创造，在技术、投入品市场准入和抵御作物冲击的韧性方面仅带来了有限的好处。这表明，在埃塞俄比亚，可能需要采取更具战略性的做法，才能使大农场的形成为小农户带来最大收益。（JEL Q18, Q24）

title: Gendered Incidence and Impacts of Tenure Insecurity on Agricultural Performance in Malawi's Customary Tenure System
abstract: Malawi’s recent passage of Land Acts provide an opportunity to clarify different aspects of the country’s land tenure in an integrated way. To assess whether doing so might be economically justified, we explore incidence and impact of tenure insecurity among smallholders. Insecurity is not only widespread, with 22 per cent of land users being concerned about losing their land, but is also associated with a productivity loss of 9 per cent for female operators, equivalent to US$ 11 million per year at the national level, enough to pay for a nation-wide tenureregularisation programme in two to three years.
abstract_zh: 马拉维近期通过的《土地法》为以综合方式厘清该国土地权属的不同方面提供了契机。为评估这样做是否具有经济上的合理性，我们考察了小农户土地权属不安全的发生情况及其影响。土地权属不安全不仅普遍存在，有22%的土地使用者担心失去土地，而且还与女性经营者9%的生产力损失相关，相当于全国每年1,100万美元，足以在两至三年内为一项全国性的土地权属确认计划提供资金。

title: Spillover Effects of Tobacco Farms on the Labor Supply, Education, and Health of Children: Evidence from Malawi
abstract: Using data from the Living Standards Measurement Study in Malawi, we examine the spillover effects of tobacco farms on children’s labor supply, education, and health. To address potential endogeneity, the share of tobacco farms in a community is instrumented by the change in tobacco buyers following termination of the intermediate buyer system. We find that, as tobacco cultivation is labor-intensive, children in communities with more tobacco growers spend more time as casual laborers and are less likely to advance to the next grade. Adverse health effects, measured by the likelihood of suffering from illnesses related to green tobacco sickness, are estimated to be larger than previously documented. This affects not only “working-age” children but also children too young to work on tobacco farms. Moreover, exposure to large-scale tobacco cultivation is estimated to reduce the height-for-age z-score of children aged 6–60 months. These findings highlight the importance of raising awareness and taking measures to protect children against green tobacco.
abstract_zh: 利用马拉维生活水平测量调查（Living Standards Measurement Study）的数据，我们考察烟草种植农场对儿童劳动供给、教育和健康的溢出效应。为应对潜在的内生性问题，社区中烟草农场的份额以中间收购商制度终止后烟草收购商的变化作为工具变量。我们发现，由于烟草种植属于劳动密集型产业，烟草种植户较多的社区中的儿童花费更多时间从事临时体力劳动，并且升入下一年级的可能性更低。以绿烟草病（green tobacco sickness）相关疾病的患病可能性衡量的不良健康效应，估计比以往文献记载的更大。这不仅影响到“劳动年龄”的儿童，也影响到年龄太小、无法在烟草农场工作的儿童。此外，接触大规模烟草种植估计会降低6至60个月大儿童的年龄别身高z评分。这些发现凸显了提高认识并采取措施保护儿童免受绿烟草危害的重要性。

Determinants of Productivity and Structural Change in a Large Commercial Farm Environment: Evidence from Ukraine
abstract: The coincidence of productivity improvements and growth of agriholdings in Ukraine over the last decade is often interpreted as evidence of technology-induced increasing returns to scale and superiority of very large farms. Panel data for the country’s commercial farms in 2001–2012 do not allow us to reject the hypothesis of constant returns to scale but point toward the importance of farms and rayon- (district) fixed effects. This suggests productivity growth was driven by exit of unproductive and entry of more efficient farms. Higher initial shares of area under farms above 3,000 or 5,000 ha at rayon level significantly reduce subsequent exit, pointing towards one channel through which land concentration may reduce productivity growth.
abstract_zh: 过去十年乌克兰生产率的提高与大型农业控股公司（agriholdings）的扩张同时出现，这一现象常被解释为技术驱动的规模报酬递增以及超大型农场更具优势的证据。2001至2012年该国商业农场的面板数据不能拒绝规模报酬不变的假设，但表明农场层面和专区（raion，即地区）层面的固定效应十分重要。这表明生产率增长主要来自低效率农场的退出以及更高效农场的进入。专区层面上，3,000公顷或5,000公顷以上农场所经营土地的初始份额较高，会显著降低随后的农场退出率，这指向土地集中可能降低生产率增长的一条渠道。

title: Does Land Fragmentation Increase the Cost of Cultivation? Evidence from India
New Ways to Assess and Enhance Land Registry Sustainability: Evidence from Rwanda
abstract: Rwanda has recently implemented a nation-wide program of first-time land regularization (LTR) that many believe set new standards for the region. We use administrative data combined with household survey- and program-rollout information to explore sustainability of the infrastructure created in this process, including the impact of public efforts to increase registration of subsequent transactions. We find that the program provided significant benefits in terms of gender equality and credit access while opening up new opportunities in terms of land taxation or land use planning, but that high level of rural informality may undermine these in the medium to long term. While public efforts to decentralize service provision helped to significantly reduce informality, additional efforts are likely to be needed to ensure sustainability of the registry. We discuss how Rwanda can further move in this direction and draw out implications for other countries considering first time adjudication and registration of property rights.
abstract_zh: 卢旺达近期在全国范围内实施了首次土地确权登记（first-time land regularization，LTR）项目，许多人认为该项目为本地区树立了新标准。我们利用行政数据，结合住户调查数据和项目推进信息，考察这一过程中所建立基础设施的可持续性，包括公共部门为提高后续交易登记率所作努力的影响。我们发现，该项目在性别平等和信贷获取方面带来了显著收益，同时为土地税收或土地利用规划开辟了新机遇；但农村地区的高度非正规性在中长期可能削弱这些收益。公共部门推动服务下放虽然显著降低了非正规性，但仍需进一步努力以确保登记系统的可持续性。我们讨论了卢旺达如何在这一方向上继续推进，并总结了其他考虑首次裁定和登记产权的国家可以借鉴的启示。

title: Smallholders' land access in Sub-Saharan Africa: A new landscape?
Using National Statistics to Increase Transparency of Large Land Acquisition: Evidence from Ethiopia
Investigating the Gender Gap in Agricultural Productivity: Evidence from Uganda
abstract: Women comprise 50 percent of the agricultural labor force in Sub-Saharan Africa, but manage plots that are reportedly on average 20 to 30 percent less productive. As a source of income inequality and aggregate productivity loss, the country-specific magnitude and drivers of this gender gap are of great interest. Using national data from the Uganda National Panel Survey for 2009/10 and 2010/11, the gap before controlling for endowments was estimated to be 17.5 percent. Panel data methods were combined with an Oaxaca decomposition to investigate the gender differences in resource endowment and return to endowment driving this gap. Although men have greater access to inputs, input use is so low and inverse returns to plot size so strong in Uganda that smaller female-managed plots have a net endowment advantage of 12 percent, revealing a larger unexplained gap of 29.5 percent. Two-fifths of this unexplained gap is attributed to differential returns to the child dependency ratio and one-fifth to differential returns to transport access, implying that greater child care responsibilities and difficulty accessing input and output markets from areas without transport are the largest drivers of the gap. Smaller and less robust drivers include differential uptake of cash crops, and differential uptake and return to improved seeds and pesticides.
abstract_zh: 撒哈拉以南非洲的农业劳动力中女性占50%，但据报道，她们管理的地块平均生产率要低20%至30%。作为收入不平等和总体生产率损失的一个来源，各国具体的性别差距规模及其驱动因素备受关注。利用乌干达全国面板调查2009/10年和2010/11年的数据，在控制禀赋之前，估计的性别差距为17.5%。我们将面板数据方法与奥克萨卡分解（Oaxaca decomposition）相结合，考察驱动这一差距的资源禀赋差异及禀赋回报差异。尽管男性更容易获得投入品，但在乌干达，投入品的使用水平极低，且土地面积的反向回报非常强，因此规模较小、由女性经营的地块在禀赋上具有12%的净优势，从而揭示出29.5%的更大未解释差距。该未解释差距的五分之二归因于儿童抚养比的差异化回报，五分之一归因于交通可达性的差异化回报，这意味着更重的育儿责任以及身处缺乏交通地区、难以进入投入品和产出市场，是导致差距的最主要原因。规模较小、稳健性较弱的驱动因素还包括经济作物采用率的差异，以及改良种子和农药的采用率及其回报的差异。

title: Quantifying Spillover Effects from Large Land-based Investment: The Case of Mozambique
Small price incentives increase women's access to land titles in Tanzania
Short-term effects of India's employment guarantee program on labor markets and agricultural productivity
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
abstract: This paper uses a large national household panel from 1999/2000 and 2007/08 to analyze the short-term effects of India's Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme on wages, labor supply, agricultural labor use, and productivity. The scheme prompted a 10-point wage increase and higher labor supply to nonagricultural casual work and agricultural self-employment. Program-induced drops in hired labor demand were more than outweighed by more intensive use of family labor, machinery, fertilizer, and diversification to crops with higher risk-return profiles, especially by small farmers. Although the aggregate productivity effects were modest, total employment generated by the program (but not employment in irrigation-related activities) significantly increased productivity, suggesting alleviation of liquidity constraints and implicit insurance provision rather than quality of works undertaken as a main channel for program-induced productivity effects.
abstract_zh: 本文利用1999/2000年和2007/08年的大型全国家庭面板数据，分析印度《圣雄甘地全国农村就业保障计划》（Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme）对工资、劳动供给、农业雇佣劳动以及生产率的短期影响。该计划使工资提高了10个卢比，并增加了非农临时工作和农业自雇的劳动供给。计划引致的雇佣劳动需求下降，被家庭劳动、机械、化肥的更密集使用，以及向风险收益特征更高的作物多样化所抵消，且这一效应在小农中尤为明显。尽管总体生产率效应温和，但该计划产生的总就业（但不包括与灌溉相关活动的就业）显著提高了生产率，表明该计划对生产率的影响主要通过缓解流动性约束和提供隐性保险实现，而非依靠所开展工程的质量。

title: Does Female Reservation Affect Long-Term Political Outcomes? Evidence from Rural India
Is There a Farm Size-Productivity Relationship in African Agriculture? Evidence from Rwanda
abstract: Whether the negative relationship between farm size and productivity that is confirmed in a large global literature holds in Africa is of considerable policy relevance. This paper revisits this issue and examines potential causes of the inverse productivity relationship in Rwanda, where policy makers consider land fragmentation and small farm sizes to be key bottlenecks for the growth of the agricultural sector. Nationwide plot-level data from Rwanda point toward a constant returns to scale crop production function and a strong negative relationship between farm size and output per hectare as well as intensity of labor use that is robust across specifications. The inverse relationship continues to hold if profits with family labor valued at shadow wages are used, but disappears if family labor is rather valued at village-level market wage rates. These findings imply that, in Rwanda, labor market imperfections, rather than other unobserved factors, seem to be a key reason for the inverse farm-size productivity relationship.
abstract_zh: 农场规模与生产率之间的负相关关系在大量全球文献中得到证实，这一关系在非洲是否成立具有相当大的政策意义。本文重新审视这一问题，并考察卢旺达农场反向生产率关系的可能成因。卢旺达的政策制定者认为土地细碎化和小农场规模是农业部门增长的关键瓶颈。来自卢旺达的全国地块层面数据表明，农作物生产函数呈规模报酬不变，且农场规模与单位面积产出以及劳动使用强度之间存在稳健的显著负相关关系，该结论在不同设定下均成立。若以影子工资估价家庭劳动计算利润，该反向关系依然存在；但若以村庄层面的市场工资率估价家庭劳动，该关系则消失。这些发现表明，在卢旺达，劳动力市场的不完善而非其他不可观测因素，似乎是农场规模与生产率反向关系的关键原因。

title: Causes and Implications of Credit Rationing in Rural Ethiopia: The Importance of Zonal Variation
Credit Constraints and Agricultural Productivity: Evidence from rural Rwanda
abstract: While potentially negative impacts of credit constraints on economic development have long been discussed conceptually, empirical evidence for Africa remains limited. We use a direct elicitation approach on a national sample of Rwandan rural households to empirically assess the extent and nature of credit rationing in the semi-formal sector and its impact, using an endogenous switching model. Elimination of all constraints could increase output by some 17 per cent. Implications for policy and research are spelled out.
abstract_zh: 尽管信贷约束对经济发展的潜在负面影响长期以来在理论上受到讨论，但非洲的经验证据仍然有限。我们采用直接询问法，基于卢旺达农村住户的全国性样本，并使用内生转换模型（endogenous switching model），从经验上评估半正规部门信贷配给的程度、性质及其影响。若消除所有约束，产出可增加约17%。本文阐述了其政策和研究含义。

title: Environmental and gender impacts of land tenure regularization in Africa: Pilot evidence from Rwanda
abstract: Although increased global demand for land has led to renewed interest in African land tenure, few models to address these issues quickly and at the required scale have been identified or evaluated. The case of Rwanda's nation-wide and relatively low-cost land tenure regularization program is thus of great interest. This paper evaluates the short-term impact (some 2.5 years after completion) of the pilots undertaken to fine-tune the approach using a geographic discontinuity design with spatial fixed effects. Three key findings emerge from the analysis. First, the program improved land access for legally married women (about 76 percent of married couples) and prompted better recordation of inheritance rights without gender bias. Second, the analysis finds a very large impact on investment and maintenance of soil conservation measures. This effect was particularly pronounced for female headed households, suggesting that this group had suffered from high levels of tenure insecurity, which the program managed to reduce. Third, land market activity declined, allowing rejection of the hypothesis that the program caused a wave of distress sales or widespread landlessness by vulnerable people. Implications for program design and policy are discussed.
abstract_zh: 尽管全球对土地需求的增长使非洲土地保有制度重新受到关注，但能够快速、大规模解决这些问题的模式却鲜有被识别或评估。卢旺达全国推行、成本相对较低的土地保有确权项目因此备受关注。本文利用地理断点设计（geographic discontinuity design）并控制空间固定效应，评估了为完善该做法而开展的试点项目的短期影响（项目结束约两年半之后）。分析得出三个关键发现。第一，该项目改善了合法已婚女性（约占已婚夫妇的76%）的土地获取，并促使继承权的登记在没有性别偏见的情况下得到改善。第二，分析发现该项目对土壤保持措施的投资和维护产生了非常大的影响。这一效应在女性户主家庭中尤为突出，表明该群体此前面临严重的保有权不安全问题，而该项目有效降低了这种不安全性。第三，土地市场交易活动下降，因此可以拒绝该项目引发了大规模低价抛售或弱势群体普遍失地的假说。本文讨论了该项目设计和政策的含义。

title: Identifying and addressing land governance constraints to support intensification and land market operation: Evidence from 10 African countries
Moving Off the Farm: Land Institutions to Facilitate Structural Transformation and Agricultural Productivity Growth in China
abstract: Agriculture has made major contributions to China's economic growth and poverty reduction, but the literature has rarely focused on the institutional factors that might underpin such structural transformation and productivity. This paper aims to fill that gap. Drawing on an 8-year panel of 1,200 households in six key provinces, it explores the impact of government land reallocations and formal land-use certificates on agricultural productivity growth, as well as the likelihood of households to exit from agriculture or send family members to the non-farm sector. It finds that land tenure insecurity, measured by the history of past land reallocations, discourages households from quitting agriculture. The recognition of land rights through formal certificates encourages the temporary migration of rural labor. Both factors have a large impact on productivity (at about 30 percent each), mainly by encouraging market-based land transfers. A sustained increase in non-agricultural opportunities will likely reinforce the importance of secure land tenure, which is a precondition for successful structural transformation and continued economic attractiveness of rural areas.
abstract_zh: 农业为中国的经济增长和减贫做出了重大贡献，但文献很少关注可能支撑这种结构转型和生产率提高的制度因素。本文旨在填补这一空白。基于六个主要省份1,200户家庭的八年面板数据，本文考察了政府土地重新分配和正式土地使用证书对农业生产率增长的影响，以及农户退出农业或让家庭成员转向非农部门的可能性。研究发现，以过去土地重新分配的历史衡量的土地保有不安全性，会抑制农户退出农业。通过正式证书确认土地权利，则促进了农村劳动力的临时迁移。这两个因素对生产率都有很大影响（各约30%），主要是通过促进以市场为基础的土地流转实现的。非农就业机会的持续增加很可能会强化安全土地保有的重要性，而安全的土地保有是成功结构转型以及农村地区持续经济吸引力的前提条件。

abstract: Recent strong commodity prices have led to increased investor interest in farmland. Global analysis indicates that suitable land to bring into cultivation is available but concentrated in a limited number of land-abundant countries in Africa, Latin America, and Southeast Asia. In a much larger number of countries, productivity on currently cultivated land is significantly below potential. Higher returns to farming and relatively cheap land have contributed to a wave of investments into farming, mostly through very large ventures in land-rich countries. If land and other markets work well and a regulatory framework is in place, there are opportunities to generate considerable benefits by providing access to capital, technology, and new markets. However, investments have often been controversial because poor land governance and weak institutional capacity have made many of these ventures economically, socially, or environmentally unsustainable. Strengthening land governance and institutions and increasing public investment to raise smallholder productivity are major priorities for most countries to improve development outcomes from these investments.
abstract_zh: 近期强劲的大宗商品价格促使投资者对农田的兴趣增加。全球分析表明，适宜开垦的土地确实存在，但集中分布于非洲、拉丁美洲和东南亚的少数土地富饶国家。而在更多的国家，现有耕地的生产率远低于其潜力。较高的农业回报和相对廉价的土地，推动了农业投资的热潮，且大多以规模非常大的项目形式出现在土地富饶的国家。如果土地和其他市场运转良好，并建立了完善的监管框架，通过提供资本、技术和新市场的渠道，便有机会创造可观的收益。然而，由于土地治理薄弱和制度能力不足，许多此类项目在经济、社会或环境上难以持续，因此这些投资常常引发争议。加强土地治理和制度建设，并增加公共投资以提高小农生产率，是大多数国家从这些投资中获得更好发展成果的主要优先事项。

abstract: Land reforms have played a central role in the political economy of many countries in the world and have been subject to massive disagreements between different political interest groups and ideologies. The 20th century included many of the largest social land reform experiments in history, as in the erstwhile Soviet Union and in Eastern Europe, China, Vietnam and Ethiopia. Many of these reforms have since been partly reversed. In other countries with a colonial history, there have been tensions between the property rights established during the colonial period and traditional (customary) land rights; the ways to adapt these to changing conditions have become critical issues. Some countries have had very skewed land distributions rooted in ethnic, colonial and other historical circumstances, and this skew has created demands for land redistribution, both to reduce discrimination and poverty, and to stimulate economic development. abstract: Albania's radical farmland distribution is credited with averting an economic crisis and social unrest during the transition. But many believe it led to a holding structure too fragmented to be efficient, and that public efforts to consolidate plots are needed to lay the foundation for greater rural productivity. This paper uses farm-level data from the 2005 Albania Living Standards Measurement Survey to explore this quantitatively. The analysis finds no support for the argument that fragmentation reduces productivity. However, producers fail to utilize about 10 percent of the country's productive land, and, in the majority of cases, this land has been idle for at least five years. Farmers quote inefficiently-small plots as the reason for this in few cases, casting doubt on the scope for land consolidation to solve this issue. Instead, the data are consistent with the notion of land market imperfections, which can be traced to gaps in the legal and policy framework, as well as inefficiencies in registry operations, leading to land abandonment on a large scale. To maintain the productive potential of Albania's rural economy and, if and when needed, the ability to conduct consolidation in a cost-effective and sustainable manner, it will be critical to complement the emphasis on consolidation with an effort to address those gaps and inefficiencies on a priority basis.
abstract_zh: 阿尔巴尼亚激进的农地分配在转型期间被认为避免了经济危机和社会动荡。但许多人认为，这导致了过于细碎、难以高效经营的持有结构，因此需要政府努力整合地块，为农村生产率的提高奠定基础。本文利用2005年阿尔巴尼亚生活水平测量调查的农场层面数据对此进行定量分析。分析未发现支持细碎化降低生产率这一论点的证据。然而，生产者未能利用全国约10%的生产性土地，而且在大多数情况下，这些土地已闲置至少五年。少数农户将地块过小视为闲置的原因，这使得通过土地整合解决该问题的空间受到质疑。相反，数据与土地市场不完善的观点相一致，而这种不完善可以追溯到法律和政策框架的缺口以及登记管理运作的低效，从而导致大规模的土地撂荒。为维持阿尔巴尼亚农村经济的生产潜力，并在必要时能够以具有成本效益且可持续的方式进行整合，关键在于在重视土地整合的同时，优先着手解决这些缺口和低效问题。

title: The Rise of Large Farms in Land Abundant Countries: Do They Have a Future?
abstract: Increased levels and volatility of food prices has led to a surge of interest in large-scale agriculture and land acquisition. This creates challenges for policy makers aiming to establish a policy environment conducive to an agrarian structure to contribute to broad-based development in the long term. Based on a historical review of episodes of growth of large farms and their impact, this paper identifies factors underlying the dominance of owner-operated farm structures and ways in which these may change with development. The amount of land that could potentially be available for expansion and the level of productivity in exploiting available land resources are used to establish a country-level typology. The authors highlight that an assessment of the advantages of large operations, together with information on endowments, can provide input into strategy formulation at the country level. A review of recent cases of land acquisition reinforces the importance of the policy framework in determining outcomes. It suggests that transparency and contract enforcement, recognition of local land rights and ways in which they can be exercised, attention to employment effects and technical viability, and mechanisms to re-allocate land from unsuccessful ventures to more productive entrepreneurs are key areas warranting the attention of policy makers.
abstract_zh: 粮食价格水平的提高和波动加剧，引发了人们对大规模农业和土地征购的浓厚兴趣。这给政策制定者带来了挑战，他们需要营造有利的政策环境，以建立一种能够在长期内促进广泛发展的农业结构。本文基于对大农场增长案例及其影响的历史回顾，识别出自有经营农场结构占主导地位的潜在因素，以及这些因素随发展可能发生的变化方式。可用于扩张的潜在土地数量以及利用现有土地资源的生产率水平，被用来建立国家层面的类型学。作者强调，评估大规模经营的优势，并结合禀赋信息，可以为国家层面的战略制定提供依据。对近期土地征购案例的回顾强调了政策框架在决定结果中的重要性。研究表明，透明度和合同执行、对当地土地权利的承认及其行使方式、对就业效应和技术可行性的关注，以及将土地从失败项目重新配置给更具生产力企业家的机制，是政策制定者需要重点关注的关键领域。

abstract: Economists have often neglected the role of the community as a third pillar in the economic system next to the state and the market. Yet in agricultural development, which is often thwarted by both market and state failures, the “community mechanism” has a particular and promising role to play. It is one of Yujiro Hayami’s unique contributions to the economics literature that he developed “a conceptual framework for economists” that emphasizes the role of communities and shows how the contested concept of social capital can be applied to analyze them from an economic perspective (Hayami, 2009). At the same time, Hayami is not a “community romanticist” — he is well aware that, just like states and markets, communities can also fail. These keywords were added by machine and not by the authors. This process is experimental and the keywords may be updated as the learning algorithm improves.
abstract_zh: 经济学家常常忽视社区作为继国家和市场之后经济体系第三支柱的作用。然而，在农业发展中，市场失灵和国家失灵常常使其受阻，“社区机制”在这里具有特殊而有前景的作用。Yujiro Hayami对经济学文献的一项独特贡献，在于他提出了“面向经济学家的概念框架”，强调社区的作用，并展示了如何从经济视角运用有争议的社会资本概念来分析社区（Hayami, 2009）。与此同时，Hayami并非“社区浪漫主义者”——他很清楚，与国家和市场一样，社区也会失灵。这些关键词由机器添加，并非作者添加。该过程仍在试验阶段，随着学习算法的改进，关键词可能会更新。

abstract: We use a survey of small rural enterprises from Tanzania to identify subjective as well as objective obstacles to expansion and productivity of the country's rural non-farm sector. Our results suggest that infrastructure constraints significantly reduce participation in the sector and investment and productivity by existing enterprises. Such constraints are particularly harmful for small enterprises, suggesting that policies to improve delivery of key public services can provide a basis for rural non-farm development, with possible knock-on effects on poverty reduction.
abstract_zh: 我们利用坦桑尼亚小型农村企业的调查数据，识别阻碍该国农村非农部门扩张和生产率提高的主观及客观障碍。结果表明，基础设施约束显著降低了该部门的参与度，也降低了现有企业的投资和生产率。此类约束对小企业的危害尤为严重，这表明改善关键公共服务的供给政策可以为农村非农发展奠定基础，并可能对减贫产生连带效应。

abstract: While the need for land‐related investment for sustainable land management and increased productivity is well recognized, quantitative evidence on agricultural productivity effects of secure property rights in Africa is scant. Within‐household analysis of investments by owner‐cum‐occupants in Uganda points toward significant and quantitatively large investment effects of full ownership. Registration is estimated to have no investment effects, whereas measures to strengthen occupancy rights attenuate investment disincentives. While this supports the importance of secure tenure as a precondition for growth, it also suggests that interventions aiming to increase tenure security need to be context‐specific for it to be fully effective.
abstract_zh: 尽管人们充分认识到，为实现可持续土地管理和提高生产率需要进行与土地相关的投资，但关于非洲安全产权对农业生产率影响的定量证据仍然稀少。利用乌干达业主兼自住者投资的家庭内部分析表明，完全所有权对投资具有显著且定量上较大的影响。登记不产生投资效应，而加强占用权的措施则能减弱投资抑制。这一结果支持了安全保有作为增长前提的重要性，但也表明，为使旨在提高土地保有安全性的干预措施充分有效，需要因地制宜。

abstract: We estimate the probability of deforestation at the plot level for Chiapas and Oaxaca, two poor Mexican states with high levels of biodiversity. Results highlight the importance of physio‐geographic endowments as well as policy variables and allow to test explicitly for aggregation bias. They also suggest that, if combined with information on the biodiversity value of specific plots, such models could be of great relevance for policy by allowing to identify the ex ante risk of deforestation.
abstract_zh: 我们在地块层面估计了奇亚帕斯州（Chiapas）和瓦哈卡州（Oaxaca）的毁林概率，这两个墨西哥州经济贫困且生物多样性水平较高。结果突出了自然地理禀赋以及政策变量的重要性，并允许对加总偏误（aggregation bias）进行明确检验。研究还表明，如果将这类模型与特定地块的生物多样性价值信息相结合，它们将对政策具有重要意义，因为其可用于识别毁林的事前风险。

abstract: Political outcomes - such as agricultural taxation, subsidization, and the provision of public goods - result from political bargaining among interest groups. Such bargaining is likely to be efficiency-enhancing and growth-enhancing when equally powerful interest groups - aware of the economywide budget constraint and know the economic implications of different policy options - participate, and when impartial institutions are available to enforce decisions. The greater the deviation from these conditions, the greater the potential for efficiency-reducing outcomes, the costs of which will generally fall disproportionately on politically underrepresented or powerless groups. Material conditions of agriculture production - such as spatial dispersion, seasonal work cycles, covariance of risk, and the associated market imperfections - exacerbate the difficulties faced by small producers to engage in collective action. So, despite being generally the economically most efficient form of production, family farmers'ability to counteract the political influence of rural elites and urban dwellers is extremely limited. Lack of independent institutions and clearly defined property rights - and the presence of organizational residues - not only reduce peasants'bargaining power but may also make it more profitable for powerful groups to prefer rent seeking to productive activities. How can these undesirable outcomes be avoided, and how can sustainable policy changes be initiated? Experience indicates that fiscal crises of the state, often triggered or aggravated by an external shock, can cause lasting changes of policies and institutions. By forcing the state to devolve some of its power in exchange for financial assistance to meet its immediate needs, such a crisis can give rise to the emergence of independent legal, political, and economic institutions that are maintained even once the crisis has subsided, External actors that provide resources in terms of crisis and at the same time enhance the scope for politically least vocal parts of civil society to participate in political discourse can have a significant impact on changing policy. The paper discusses in detail the implications for research as well as for policy advice.
abstract_zh: 农业税收、补贴以及公共物品供给等政治结果，源于利益集团之间的政治博弈。当势均力敌的利益集团参与其中，且它们了解经济范围的预算约束和不同政策选项的经济含义，同时存在公正的制度来执行决策时，这种博弈可能提高效率并促进增长。偏离这些条件的程度越大，导致效率下降的可能性就越大，而其成本通常会不成比例地落在政治上代表性不足或缺乏权力的群体身上。农业生产的物质条件，例如空间分散、季节性作业周期、风险的协方差以及由此产生的市场不完善，加剧了小生产者进行集体行动的困难。因此，尽管家庭农场通常是经济上最有效率的生产形式，但其抵御农村精英和城市居民政治影响的能力却极为有限。独立制度和清晰产权的缺失，以及组织残余的存在，不仅削弱了农民的议价能力，还可能使强势集团更倾向于寻租而非从事生产性活动。如何避免这些不良结果，又如何启动可持续的政策变革？经验表明，国家的财政危机往往由外部冲击引发或加剧，可以引起政策和制度的持久变化。通过迫使国家以权力下放为代价换取满足其迫切需求的财政援助，此类危机可能催生独立的法律、政治和经济制度，并且在危机过去之后仍能保留下来。同时，为政治上最缺乏发言权的社会群体提供危机资源并扩大其参与政治讨论的空间的外部行为体，可能对政策变革产生重大影响。本文详细讨论了这对研究和政策咨询的含义。

abstract: This chapter focuses on a number of methodological approaches which have been used to explain land relations—tenancy, sharecropping and interlinking, distress sales, dualistic land ownership distributions, classes, and land reform—and their variations over space and time. It argues that the explanatory power of theories on land relations hinges on the complexity, market imperfections, and distortions admitted in the analysis. The chapter illustrates that only a framework that, in addition to asymmetric information, accounts for material characteristics of agricultural production, rent seeking, and policy distortions, can satisfactorily explain the phenomena characteristic of agricultural land markets in LDCs. It shows that the emergence of large farms in many developing countries was based on power relations and distortions, and also argues that the international competitiveness of these farms is often maintained by subsidies, associated with significant social losses. The transition from landlord estates to family farms in a market economy has led to stable systems of production relations.
abstract_zh: 本章聚焦于若干用于解释土地关系的方法论途径，包括佃农制、分成制与互联交易、低价抛售、二元土地所有制分布、阶级以及土地改革，并考察其在空间和时间上的变化。本章认为，关于土地关系的理论解释力取决于分析中所纳入的复杂性、市场不完善性和扭曲。本章说明，只有在考虑非对称信息之外，还考虑农业生产的物质特征、寻租行为和政策扭曲的框架下，才能令人满意地解释发展中国家农业土地市场的典型现象。研究表明，许多发展中国家大型农场的兴起基于权力关系和扭曲，同时也认为，这些农场的国际竞争力往往依靠补贴维持，并伴随重大社会损失。在市场经济中，从地主庄园向家庭农场的转变已形成稳定的生产关系体系。

title: South African land policy: The legacy of history and current options
